propositions: rebar search does not match tickets by their canonical ticket_id, human alias, or bound Jira key because _haystack builds the searchable text from only title, description, tags, and comment bodies, excluding all identifiers
rebar search returns empty results when a user searches for a bound Jira key that rebar show correctly resolves, causing users to wrongly believe the ticket does not exist

_haystack must be extended to include lowercased ticket_id, alias, and jira_key fields; the jira_key enrichment must happen in the search_state caller to keep search_states pure and avoid filesystem access inside the reducer
identifier matching must be case-insensitive so that searching for uppercase REB-1654 matches a ticket bound to the same key via case-folded comparison on both sides
